criteria.name: Purposeful opening
criteria.description: Establishes relevance and earns attention without a vague or unsupported pitch.

criteria.name: Discovery
criteria.description: Asks useful questions and adapts to what the buyer says.

criteria.name: Objection handling
criteria.description: Addresses the buyer's underlying concern with a specific and credible response.

criteria.name: Concrete next step
criteria.description: Earns a specific mutual next step with ownership and timing.
